title: 50% Profit in 45 Days. In 1920. #Shorts
title_alternatives: He Needed 160 Million Coupons. There Were 27,000.
The Man Whose Name Became a Scam
description:
Before crypto, there was Charles Ponzi: 50% profit in 45 days, Boston, 1920.

The math: paying everyone would have taken 160 million postal reply coupons. About 27,000 existed. Six banks failed, investors lost ~$20M, and he died with a $75 estate.

Sources: Wikipedia, Charles Ponzi (citing Zuckoff, Ponzi's Scheme, 2005).
Sounds: CC0 recordings from Freesound (full list in the pinned comment / on request).

AI-narrated. Educational entertainment, not financial advice.
